rv.q: The team at the Hope Mill have put on a strong show. The performers, musicians, and production elements are all high quality.
Lizzie The Musical is a gloriously gonzo experience, a full-blown rock epic performed by a talented cast determined to ensure the audience has a, ahem, bloody good time.

cn.t: Critics praise this over-the-top rock musical for its bold energy and innovation, with the Hope Mill Theatre's production delivering a compelling take on the infamous Lizzie Borden murder case.
